_comment: Tier-2 for febio::linear_elasticity#5. <nu> inside 'isotropic elastic' gives 'tag "nu" (line N) : unrecognized tag' with 'Reading file ...FAILED!' and exit 1; the same deck with <v> runs to normal termination and prints neither string. NOTE ON RE-KEYING: the fixture missing_control_silent_zero_result carried pitfall_index 5 while its subject is the dropped-<Control> pitfall, which is index 3 — the index had drifted as pitfalls were inserted, so the runner key attributed the Control evidence to the Poisson-ratio claim. Both were re-keyed in the same pass. The positive control — the same deck with only the one wrong thing put right — is what makes the observed message attributable to the trigger rather than to anything else in the deck. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 spells Poisson's ratio <v> in the "wrong" slot too. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'nu_instead_of_v=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
